title: Hookline webhook event
description: The JSON body of every Hookline delivery (milestone M9). Receivers must ignore properties they do not know: new optional properties may be added without a new version.

id.description: The event id; the same in every delivery and retry of this event (Hookline-Event-Id).

type.description: Dot-separated lowercase words, such as invoice.paid; the tenant chose it at ingest.
type.$comment: Python's re lets $ match before a final newline; Go's regexp does not. The not-pattern makes both sides reject it.

created_at.description: When Hookline accepted the event, RFC 3339.

payload.description: The tenant's payload, exactly as ingested; its shape depends on type.
